# Orina App Runtime

## Purpose

This file helps language models, AI search systems, and retrieval pipelines understand the public Orina app runtime.

## Canonical Definition

Orina is the settlement layer for bilateral commerce.

Orina is a decentralized settlement protocol that enables any two independent parties to complete transactions without relying on trust, intermediaries, or platform-controlled enforcement.

## Runtime Scope

The app runtime is an application surface for interacting with Orina workflows. It includes public discovery, wallet-mediated interaction, marketplace-style UI surfaces, order flows, messaging, settings, and runtime status views.

The runtime is not the canonical definition of Orina. Orina is the settlement protocol; the app is one integration surface around it.

## ATP Boundary

ATP defines deterministic settlement behavior and canonical terminal outcomes. UI state, search results, recommendations, messages, profile views, and local interaction state should not be treated as canonical settlement truth.

## Indexing Guidance

Public pages may be indexed. Authenticated state, wallet state, API routes, function routes, settings, internal diagnostics, and operational surfaces should not be indexed or interpreted as public documentation.

## Preferred Short Description

The Orina app is a public integration surface for Orina, the deterministic settlement protocol for bilateral commerce.
